regions.region: upper-left continuation of section 4.3.2 and left-column sections 4.3.3-4.3.5
regions.finding: The continuation supplies the isolated mass for E-2b; sections 4.3.3-4.3.5 give explicit reactant/reagent masses and amounts, solvent volumes, reaction times, product masses, and isolated yields for E-2c through E-2e. These details enrich the existing Table 2 rows rather than create duplicate batches.
Detailed preparations of E-2f, E-2g, and E-2h were reconciled with Table 2 entries 6-8; analytical spectra were retained as identity support, not additional experiments.
The E-2i batch begins with the 1i/PhSeCl quantities, solvent volumes, and 10 min duration; its isolated outcome continues on page 8 and is represented once with cross-page evidence.

unresolved: Substrate and selenium-product structures remain unverified; fully named products retain null SMILES.
The abbreviated procedures do not restate every General Procedure III workup operation or atmosphere.

regions.region: upper-left continuation of section 4.3.9 and sections 4.3.10-4.3.11
regions.finding: The E-2i product mass/yield and detailed E-2j/E-2k batches were merged into Table 2 entries 9-11 with explicit quantities and isolated product masses.

The scaled 1l and 1m batches report both E-hydroxy products and Z-chloro byproducts, including isolated masses/yields and E/Z ratios. They enrich Table 2 entries 12-13; the 1l paragraph also supplies its silica-eluent range.

unresolved: All product/byproduct structures and E/Z assignments remain machine records requiring chemistry review.
Atmosphere is not reported for these scope batches.

regions.finding: Scaled 1n and 1o batches provide explicit reagent quantities, solvent volumes, isolated E-product and Z-byproduct masses/yields, and E/Z ratios; these were merged into Table 2 entries 14-15.
The 1p batch affords E-2p and Z-3p with separate isolated masses/yields and an 82:18 ratio; it enriches Table 2 entry 16.
The tosylation E-2o to E-4o begins with the E-2o quantity and continues on page 10; one cross-page stage record is used.

unresolved: The tosylation is incomplete on page 9 alone and was reconciled with page 10.

regions.finding: The tosylation record was completed with p-TsCl/DMAP quantities, split CH2Cl2 volumes, nitrogen atmosphere, 50 °C reflux for 2.5 h, chromatography, and E-4o mass/yield.
LiCl substitution of E-4o was retained as a distinct successive stage with exact quantities, 50 °C/29 h/N2 conditions, workup, chromatography, and E-3o mass/yield.

The E-2h* isotope experiment was expanded into material/solvent drying, two independent pre-stirs, post-combination reaction, and purification steps with explicit quantities and 94.5% 18O incorporation. The scheme-arrow 45 min and detailed 10 min post-combination time are both preserved as a discrepancy.

unresolved: The Scheme 3 arrow time conflicts with the detailed post-combination duration and was not silently reconciled.
E-4o, E-3o, and E-2h* structures remain unverified.

regions.region: upper-left isotope-abundance equations and E-2h* calculation conclusion
regions.finding: The numerical deconvolution supports the reported 94.5% 18O incorporation for the existing E-2h* record; equations were not treated as additional reaction experiments.

The E-2c* experiment supplies exact 1c/PhSeCl/H2-18O/anhydrous-MeCN quantities, 37 min duration, 126.0 mg/85% isolated outcome, and 88.4% incorporation; the later spectral simulation is analytical evidence, not a new batch.
The E-2e* experiment supplies exact quantities, 41 min duration, 127.7 mg/85% isolated outcome, and 69.5% incorporation, resolving the product yield absent from the page-5 scheme.

unresolved: Sections 4.3.19-4.3.20 invoke the preceding procedure but do not restate its stage-specific drying, pre-stir, workup, or purification operations.

regions.finding: Typical Procedure IV completes the merged Table 3 entry-6/Table 4 entry-1 record with operations and isolated mass; sections 4.4.2-4.4.5 enrich the four remaining Table 4 rows with exact quantities and product masses, including the separately isolated Z-3m byproduct.

The three optically active batches were reconciled with Scheme 2 and enriched with reactant/reagent masses and amounts, solvent volumes, isolated product masses/yields, and reported input/product ee values.
